items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I fancied myself in love with Betty Hutton... I never saw her again but about six weeks later I got a call from the head of the studio, who said Betty felt pretty badly about things but she couldn't bring herself to come back on the lot and face me

ctx.x: Did you decide you wanted to be a songwriter or just found yourself being a songwriter?
It was convenient at the time to become a songwriter. I fancied myself in love with Betty Hutton.
Did she record any of your material?
